comments.author: daall
comments.body:
It looks like it's related to this change: https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/pull/1237.

It looks like there is some sort of issue polling those two counters introduced in the 3.7.3.3-4 SAI update, but this issue is only present in master, not 201911.

We're going to need do more investigating to figure out what exactly is wrong here, but for now I've opened a PR to revert the counter change to clean-up the master branch: https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/pull/1308

Once it merges I can update the submodule and resolve this issue.
